name: Neltharion's Resolve makes the party immune to fear (#3711)
contract: #3711: Neltharion's Resolve 520488 is APPLY_AREA_AURA_PARTY (effect 35, radius index 9 = 20 yd) carrying aura 77 (MECHANIC_IMMUNITY) with MiscValue 5 = MECHANIC_FEAR, 60 s. Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura and AuraEffect::HandleModMechanicImmunity are native. Probe: Fear 5782 (Spell.dbc Mechanic 5, read in the group 4 audit), queried with spell_immune against a hostile dummy as the caster. Both the caster and the grouped ally must become immune; both must stop being immune when the aura ends. Note: the ward is not consumed by the first fear (stock Fear Ward 6346 has the same shape), so no consumption is asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control: the caster is not fear immune before the cast
Control: the ally is not fear immune before the cast
The ward is on the caster
The caster is immune to Fear
The grouped ally receives the ward
The grouped ally is immune to Fear
The ward ends after its 60 s duration on the caster
Fear lands on the caster again
Fear lands on the ally again
